text:
It appears there was an error in specifying the action. The correct action for publishing test results is `codecov/codecov-action`. Below is the corrected GitHub Actions workflow file:

```yaml
name: Test Analysis

on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  download-artifacts:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2
      
      - name: Download JUnit XML artifacts from Tests workflow
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v2
        with:
          name: tests-results
          path: ./tests-results

  publish-test-results:
    needs: download-artifacts
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2
      
      - name: Set up Rust toolchain
        uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
        with:
          profile: minimal
          toolchain: stable
          override: true
      
      - name: Publish unit test results
        uses: codecov/codecov-action@v3
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}
          file: ./tests-results/*.xml
```

This workflow will trigger after the `Tests` workflow completes, download the JUnit XML artifacts, and use the `codecov/codecov-action` to add test result comments to PRs. Make sure you have a `CODECOV_TOKEN` set as a secret in your repository settings.

      - name: Publish unit test results
